name: DNA methyltransferase 1
pathways: negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: DNMT1 encodes DNA (cytosine-5)-methyltransferase 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-methyltransferase activity and DNA (cytosine-5-)-methyltransferase activity. It participates in negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and DNA methylation-dependent constitutive heterochromatin formation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia, deafness and narcolepsy (autosomal dominant); hereditary sensory neuropathy-deafness-dementia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Genomics England PanelApp. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
